title: Object Storage: cool review handling
content:
Object Storage cool review is handled on request. Complete an accountant's billing review of one storage charge using its authoritative source evidence. The selected review records its corrected net target, zero tax, an incorrect decision and approved status; the approved target becomes visible immediately on success.

## Invocation

record_storage_correction_review_dc2a1af3. This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameters

- storage_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the Billing review reference copied from find_storage_events. This is the cool review input.
- source_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the Original storage charge reference copied from the selected review returned by find_storage_events. This is the cool review input.
- related_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the Supporting storage export reference copied from the selected review returned by find_storage_events. This is the cool review input.
- storage_holding_id: Id class — Identifier of the Storage contract reference copied from find_storage_holdings. This is the cool review input.
- net_amount: Fixed-format class — Unit USD; format USD to two decimals. Corrected net target in USD, decimal format with two decimal places, half-up rounded before submission and stored at two decimals; empty is not allowed. This is the cool review input.

## Successful return

A string reading Review approved with the billing review reference and corrected USD net target; approved confirms the review is completed.
